integrity: The two input papers are cited for the operator closure, absorber bound and ring spectrum. The full-gap identity for the connected SWAP feedback model is credited to arXiv:2611.13094v2. The contribution is the star-specific complete spectral reduction, sharp topology crossover and unit-edge-clock asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The derivation computes the pair-sector spectrum for unit-per-edge-rate singlet feedback. Under the connected SWAP measurement-feedback model the full gap is the lowest pair decay rate by the cited identity; this does not determine the full spectrum or preparation time. The numerical absorber bound 2λ/n applies to the tree case with every edge active, not arbitrary feedback graphs. The growing hub measurement load prevents a claim of hardware parallel depth or equal-per-site-rate superiority. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove all-size spectra.
title: Star-graph feedback reaches the absorber-limited rate and overtakes a ring at seven qubits
